deployments_detail.use: "ISUZU AI Chat" company-wide chatbot (CB3 + Azure OpenAI), launched Mar 2024
AI for recognition/prediction/judgment in L4 autonomous truck development (RoAD to the L4 govt program, commercialization target 2027)

End-to-end AI autonomous heavy-duty trucks (Giga) running daily commercial cargo on a 450 km hub-to-hub logistics route between Tochigi and Aichi, using Applied Intuition's end-to-end autonomy model and continuous data engine; public-road operation began 2025, expanded to daily commercial operations spring 2026. [Applied Intuition]

Middle-mile SAE Level 4 autonomous medium-duty trucks: Gatik integrated its 'Gatik Driver' interpretable AI autonomy system into Isuzu medium-duty truck platforms; freight-only driverless operations across Texas, Arizona and Arkansas, targeting mass production in 2027. Isuzu invested US$30M in Gatik. [Gatik]
deployments_detail.value: US$30M Isuzu investment; 60,000 driverless deliveries; >$600M contracted revenue

deployments_detail.use: Level 4 autonomous buses (ERGA electric and diesel) developed with TIER IV, running TIER IV's Autoware-based L4 autonomous driving software on NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor SoC / DRIVE Hyperion platform for public transit, addressing Japan's driver shortage. [TIER IV, NVIDIA]

Generative design AI in Autodesk Fusion used by Isuzu Central Research Institute to optimize diesel engine gear structures, achieving a prototype gear with 43% weight reduction and 0.5% fuel-efficiency improvement while maintaining rattle-noise suppression. [Autodesk (Fusion)]
deployments_detail.value: 43% gear weight reduction; 0.5% fuel efficiency improvement

deployments_detail.use: GATEX-based connected services for battery-electric N-Series trucks providing remote uptime support: monitoring of battery SOH/SOC/remaining range, energy-saving operation reports, and predictive-maintenance advance notifications for inspection timing; launched with North America N-Series EV rollout, expanding globally. [Transtron (GATEX)]

Strategic partnership with Fujitsu to commercialize software-defined vehicles (SDVs) for commercial logistics, accelerating in-vehicle software development via Fujitsu's SDV offering under the Fujitsu Uvance business, building on Isuzu's GATEX platform (~570,000 connected vehicles). [Fujitsu (Uvance)]

IBM Envizi ESG Suite deployed at Isuzu Motors South Africa for sustainability/ESG data management, using advanced analytics and machine learning to track carbon, energy, water, waste and safety metrics; integrated with SAP/ERP, with 14 years of historical data loaded as baseline. Went live June 2025. [IBM (Envizi), Datacentrix]

Joint pilot with Fujitsu and Logistics Knight Japan to build a pharmaceutical logistics platform using Isuzu's GATEX fleet/vehicle-data platform, Fujitsu data technologies and Dynamic Supply Chain Management for real-time inventory/temperature visibility and joint-transport optimization; selected by Japan's MLIT for its Logistics Innovation Implementation Support Project. Pilot launched November 2025. [Fujitsu, Logistics Knight Japan]
